preconditions.description: The lengths of strings s and t are equal.
The length of string s is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s) and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings consist only of lowercase English letters.
String s is lexicographically smaller than string t.

postconditions.expression: if s == next_string(s, len(s)): stdout == 'No such string' else: s < stdout.strip() < t and len(stdout.strip()) == len(s) and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in stdout.strip())
postconditions.description: If s is immediately followed by t in lexicographical order (no string exists between them), output 'No such string'. Otherwise, output a string strictly between s and t with the same length and valid characters.
